email_draft.subject: Mountain View's ARD paperwork, cut in half | Journify
email_draft.body:
Your SPED team runs the full ARD and IEP process under TEA requirements, and at 14% of students receiving special education services, the documentation load on case managers and related-service providers is significant.

Most Texas SPED teams hit a wall where ARD prep, present-levels writing, and progress monitoring crowd out the actual work of serving students. Journify integrates with SEIS and Frontline to generate IEP materials in less than five minutes, so your case managers and therapists spend their hours in sessions and classrooms, not catching up on paperwork.

Open to a 20-minute walk-through this week to see how it fits your team's current workflow?
